days.title: Heritage Saigon
days.morning: Independence Palace, Notre-Dame Cathedral and the Central Post Office.
days.afternoon: War Remnants Museum and Ben Thanh Market.
days.evening: Nguyen Hue walking street and city views from Landmark 81 or Bitexco.

days.title: Tunnels and food
days.afternoon: Cho Lon and Thien Hau Temple in District 5.
days.evening: Motorbike food tour in District 4: snails, broken rice and bánh mì.

days.title: Can Gio mangroves
days.morning: Can Gio mangrove forest and Monkey Island.
days.afternoon: Swim at 30/4 beach and eat Can Gio seafood.

days.title: My Tho – Ben Tre
days.morning: My Tho, a boat on the Tien river and Thoi Son islet.
days.afternoon: Rowing boats through Ben Tre's coconut canals and traditional music.
days.evening: Back in Saigon, stroll Bui Vien street.

days.title: Tay Ninh – Ba Den mountain
days.morning: The Cao Dai Holy See in Tay Ninh.
days.afternoon: Cable car to Ba Den mountain – "the roof of Southern Vietnam".
days.evening: Back to Saigon for Trang Bang dew-dried rice paper rolls.
